items.title: Auto-commit Koala metadata writes after CLI mutations
items.context: Wrap koala CLI handlers that write under .koala/story/actives/<id>/ (validate evidence refresh, review_pass_set, finding_add, init/scope/delivery_check_set, story_advance metadata mirror, summary writers) so they stage + commit ONLY the classifier-confirmed koala_metadata paths after success. Use the dirty-worktree classifier from B-6326 to define the path set; never glob blindly. Commit message format must let users grep which command produced the metadata write.
items.userSees:
User runs e.g. `koala finding_add ...` and immediately below the primary output sees a literal line:
  ✓ koala metadata 已自动提交: koala: record B-xxxx finding_add metadata (a1b2c3d)
Running git log -1 shows the auto-committed commit with the same SHA prefix. Same pattern appears after review_pass_set, init_check_set, scope_check_set, delivery_check_set, summary_set, checklist_update, verification_evidence_add, finding_resolve.

happy.desc: After koala finding_add ... in a story/* worktree, stdout contains "✓ koala metadata 已自动提交: koala: record <storyId> finding_add metadata (<sha7>)" AND git log -1 shows the committed metadata

Same auto-commit line appears after review_pass_set, init_check_set, scope_check_set, delivery_check_set, summary_set, checklist_update, verification_evidence_add, finding_resolve in a story/* worktree

edge.desc: On non-story/* branch (e.g., main), metadata-mutating commands run normally with NO auto-commit line in output (silent skip)
Calling the helper when nothing is staged (already-committed state) returns empty string and does not produce a duplicate commit

adversarial.desc: Helper rejects at runtime if storyDirRel argument is not the canonical .koala/story/actives/<id>/ prefix (preMortem #1 anchor — prevent path broadening)

items.title: Skip auto-commit when non-metadata dirt coexists
items.context: If the classifier reports any material_source_changes, fixture_changes, declared_artifact_changes, or unexpected_dirty_files at the moment of auto-commit, leave the working tree untouched and print why. This prevents auto-commit from picking up partially edited source files alongside a metadata write. Document the exact bail-out condition so reviewers can spot accidental relaxation.
items.userSees:
User runs e.g. `koala finding_add ...` while worktree has both a metadata write AND a coexisting material_source_changes file (e.g. packages/main/src/foo.ts modified). Output shows:
  ✓ koala metadata 已自动提交: koala: record B-xxxx finding_add metadata (a1b2c3d) (coexisting non-metadata dirt left untouched: material_source_changes=1)
git status confirms src/foo.ts is still M (uncommitted), only .koala/story/actives/B-xxxx/ files were committed.

happy.desc: With coexisting material/fixture/unexpected dirt outside .koala/story/actives/<id>/, auto-commit still proceeds AND output contains tail-note (coexisting non-metadata dirt left untouched: <category>=<n>...)

edge.desc: When no coexisting non-metadata dirt exists, output does NOT contain the left-untouched tail-note (omit when irrelevant, do not print empty)
git status after auto-commit shows the material/fixture/unexpected paths STILL dirty (uncommitted) — verifies path scope did not accidentally widen

adversarial.desc: Tail-note must contain literal word untouched — never use ambiguous phrasing like handled / committed / all clean when non-metadata dirt is present (preMortem #3 anchor)
Helper uses B-6326 classifyDirtyWorktree to produce category counts in the tail-note — same vocabulary across surfaces

items.title: Surface auto-commit activity in user-visible output
items.context: Session brief, story_advance hints, and koala validate output should announce which metadata paths were auto-committed in the current invocation (sha + path list) so users see Koala's own writes accounted for separately from user-driven commits. Hide the row when no auto-commit happened.
items.userSees: User running any extended-auto-commit handler in a story/* branch sees the literal Chinese line "✓ koala metadata 已自动提交:" followed by the commit subject and SHA prefix appended to the command primary output. session_brief and koala validate output do NOT need to be modified — they already render dirty rows from B-6326 classifier; with auto-commit working, koala_metadata_changes simply does not show up because nothing is dirty.

happy.desc: Each extended handler appends ✓ koala metadata 已自动提交 line to its stdout response when auto-commit fired

edge.desc: When auto-commit was a no-op (nothing staged or not story/* branch), the line is OMITTED from output — handlers do not print empty hints

adversarial.desc: The literal Chinese phrase ✓ koala metadata 已自动提交 must match the same prefix used by story_advance for vocabulary consistency — smoke asserts byte-equal prefix

items.title: Regression-prove material/fixture stays dirty while metadata gets committed
items.context: Add a regression smoke that mutates a fake .koala/story/actives/<id>/test-evidence.json AND a fake packages/main/src/foo.ts (material) AND a fake packages/main/tests/output/x (unexpected) in one go, then asserts only the metadata file is committed and the others remain dirty with the original blocking semantics. Reuse dirty-worktree classifier so test depends on the same vocabulary.
items.userSees: Running `npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke` prints `✓ flow stability smoke passed` and asserts: handler-N writes metadata + has material file dirty → only metadata file committed, material stays M; handler-N on main branch → no commit; idempotent re-call → no duplicate commit; path-broadening helper invocation → throws.

happy.desc: Smoke fixture: temp git repo on story/B-xxx branch with one staged metadata file and one M material file → call helper → assert commit created with only metadata file, material still M
Smoke covers helper invoked from at least 3 different handlers (finding_add, checklist_update, summary_set) — all produce auto-commit line

edge.desc: Smoke: on main branch → helper returns empty string and no commit
Smoke: idempotent re-call (nothing staged) → second call returns empty string and no second commit

adversarial.desc: Smoke: passing a non-canonical storyDirRel (e.g., .koala/story/actives/B-xxx/foo or packages/main/src/.koala) makes helper throw
Smoke: classifyDirtyWorktree returns the same category counts whether helper is called or not (auto-commit does not mask material/fixture/unexpected dirt)
